newsitem.title: USA: Texas police hunt mafia-style killers of five.
newsitem.headline: Texas police hunt mafia-style killers of five.

text.p: Texas police searched on Monday for three masked gunmen who shot seven people, killing five, in a mob-style raid at a bar in this Mexico-Texas border town.

The killers entered the bar early on Saturday wearing white masks, pulled out semi-automatic handguns and made everyone inside empty their pockets before lining the victims up and opening fire at close range.
"It appears to be a professional job," said police spokesman Bill Pfeil. He said investigators were checking the possible involvement of drug traffickers or well-organised criminal gangs.
Two of those killed, the bar owner and a guitarist, were from El Paso and the other three were from New Mexico, including two horse trainers.
